canonical_project: Stargate Frontier / Vantage Shackelford County campus
aliases: Stargate Frontier / Vantage Shackelford County campus
Vantage DC Abilene - TX3 - Project Frontier

location.address_caveat: TDLR registrations list the mailing city as Abilene while the location county is Shackelford; Vantage describes the campus as Shackelford County, Texas.

status_as_of_cutoff: Site work-construction. Vantage publicly announced Frontier as a 1.4-GW, 1,200-acre Shackelford County campus with construction already begun and first-building delivery targeted for 2H 2026; Oracle's AI data-center status page says Shackelford was contracted in August 2025, customer delivery begins in 1H 2027, 115 MW of power capacity is already available, and dated May/June 2026 imagery labels VoltaGrid power and data halls. TDLR has registered 10 new data-center buildings plus one associated office building at 246 PR 1604, all with Project Registered status. No county-issued building permit, certificate of occupancy, energization record, or full-buildout record was located.

actions.result_or_status: Agenda item 8 noticed a request for tax abatement for Windfarm Data Center and action to authorize Wetsel & Lederle to represent Shackelford County.
actions.result_status: Agenda item only; no reviewed record ties this agenda item conclusively to Vantage Frontier.
actions.access_caveat: County agenda item does not identify Vantage, Frontier, Project Stargate, an approval vote, or an executed abatement.

actions.result_or_status: Vantage announced Frontier as a more-than-$25B, 1.4-GW, 1,200-acre Shackelford County campus with 10 data centers totaling 3.7M square feet; construction had begun and first building delivery was scheduled for the second half of 2026.
actions.result_status: Announced and under construction per owner/developer statement.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement is not a local building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Owner/developer primary source for capacity, scale, construction-start statement, and target delivery.

actions.result_or_status: OpenAI announced Shackelford County, Texas as one of three new Oracle-developed Stargate sites; the three Oracle sites plus an Abilene expansion can deliver over 5.5 GW of capacity.
actions.result_status: Site selected under Stargate; capacity figure is aggregate across multiple Oracle-developed sites and is not a standalone Shackelford capacity value.
actions.access_caveat: OpenAI's site announcement does not provide a Shackelford-only MW figure or local permit status.

actions.result_or_status: Oracle's AI data-center page states the Shackelford, Texas site was contracted in August 2025, customer delivery begins in 1H 2027, and 115 MW of power capacity is already available more than one month ahead of schedule; the page labels dated imagery for VoltaGrid Power on 2026-05-27 and Data Halls on 2026-06-01.
actions.result_status: Construction/progress evidence; not full customer delivery or full buildout.
actions.access_caveat: Oracle states page information is current as of January 2026 even though the page includes May/June 2026 dated project media; exact publication/update date for the Shackelford section is not separately exposed.
actions.evidence_note: Customer/operator primary source for power availability and project progress.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: TDLR registrations use 246 PR 1604, Abilene, TX 79601 while listing Location County as Shackelford; Vantage and OpenAI describe the site as Shackelford County. This appears to be a postal-city/county mismatch rather than a project-location conflict.

Vantage and Oracle provide primary-source evidence of site/data-hall construction progress, while TDLR records remain only Project Registered and reviewed county records did not expose a local building permit or certificate of occupancy. Status is therefore site work-construction, not energized, partial live, or full buildout.

history.previous_value: Vantage identifies Frontier as a 1.4-GW campus; a TDLR registration supports a planned first building, but physical construction and local approval records remain incomplete.
history.new_value: Site work-construction, supported by Vantage's construction-start statement, Oracle's May/June 2026 project-progress media and 115 MW available-power statement, and 10 TDLR data-building registrations plus one associated office-building registration; no CO/energization/full-buildout record located.
Vantage Data Centers; Vantage Data Centers TX301, LLC through Vantage Data Centers TX310, LLC are listed across TDLR data-building registrations.
